settings.text: A petite top-handle bag in calf leather. Sized for the essentials. Built for the long evening.

settings.title: Details
settings.content: A statement of quiet luxury. Smooth genuine leather and a structured silhouette take the Evening Bag from dinner to after-hours, holding just your essentials and nothing extra.

settings.title: Materials & Care
settings.content:
Material
Smooth genuine leather with polished metal hardware.

Care
Wipe clean with a soft, dry cloth and condition every 6–12 months with a neutral leather cream. Store in the dust bag, away from direct sunlight.

settings.title: Shipping & Returns
settings.content:
Free shipping on all orders over $75. Once your order is placed, it ships and arrives within 7 to 10 business days.

We accept returns within 30 days of delivery for items in original, unused condition with all tags attached. Exchanges are always free. If something isn’t right, reach out — we’ll make it right.

settings.title: Two Year Warranty
settings.content:
Every Velantra bag is covered for two years against defects in materials and construction. If anything goes wrong in normal use, we’ll repair or replace it.

After two years, we continue to offer repair service for the cost of materials. Designed to last decades, not seasons.

settings.headline: Petite, Two-Way Carry
settings.body: Small enough for the hand. Slip the chain inside for a top-handle silhouette. Drop it out for the crossbody.

settings.headline: Italian Smooth Calf
settings.body: The same leather used by the Rue Cambon houses. Soft enough to take a finish, structured enough to hold one.

settings.headline: Hand-Painted Edges
settings.body: Eight coats of edge paint, hand-sanded between each. The kind of detail you only notice when it’s missing.

settings.headline: Phone, card, key
settings.body: Three slots in microsuede — a phone on one side, a card case and key on the other.

settings.headline: Convertible chain
settings.body: Slim gold-tone chain that drops out or tucks inside. Top-handle for dinner. Crossbody for after.

settings.headline: Magnetic plus hidden snap
settings.body: Holds without a click. Opens without a fumble.
